title: BixECG: A Compact, Uncertainty-Aware mLSTM Model for Real-Time ECG Delineation on Edge Devices
description: Official code and pretrained weights for the paper "A Compact, Uncertainty-Aware mLSTM Model for Real-Time ECG Delineation on Edge Devices" (Lung et al., 2026; manuscript under review). BixECG is a 2,522-parameter bidirectional matrix-memory LSTM (Bi-mLSTM) for per-sample P/QRS/T/No-Wave delineation, with tolerance-aware evaluation, uncertainty quantification (softmax confidence, entropy, calibration), and a real-time on-device deployment (Arduino Portenta H7, Cortex-M7) streaming from a wearable ECG monitor. Version 1.1.0 makes the FINAL weights reported in the paper the default (bixecg_mlstm_2522_detaug.pt: detector-anchored training windows + augmentation; tolerance-aware macro-F1 under detector-anchored evaluation 0.921 on LUDB and 0.878 on LVAD-DB pooled across two raters) and keeps the earlier pilot-firmware weights (bixecg_mlstm_2522.pt: annotation-anchored, no augmentation; deployed in the on-device pilot reported in the paper) as a second, labelled weight set. It adds the firmware-format export of the final weights and the detector-anchored training/evaluation script. No patient data are included.
